name: ws2812b_8x8
title: WS2812B panel, 8x8
description: 64 WS2812B in a square of 8 by 8 on a rigid board, one data line through all of them: IN at one corner, OUT at the opposite one goes on into the next panel
notes: QYF-0728 on the back. In what order the data line goes through the LEDs, row by row or as a snake, is not known: a trial shows it.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his panel, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his panel, 2026-11-13, straightened

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his panel, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: Pads on the back, their names printed mirrored: V+ IN V- at one corner, V+ OUT V- at the opposite one.

silkscreen.source: the back of the panel: WS2812B-64, Only ONE Pin, 24 bit color, 64 RGB LEDs; the volts are those of the WS2812B. Not tried.
